item: The style non-growth ratchet ceiling drops from 417 to 414 (zero slack on main 7033552e7)
summary: scripts/ruff_ratchet.py, run at the old ceiling on main 7033552e7, said the ceiling can be lowered to 414; the ci.yml step now says 414. CI measures the merge of the PR into the base tip as it stands when the run starts, so a finding another PR lands first reddens the next run of whichever PR merges second. scripts/guards_for_diff.py reads the ceiling from ci.yml, so a pre-push run picks up 414 once main is merged in. The other 417s in the tree are test fixtures (tests/test_ruff_ratchet.py, tests/test_guards_for_diff.py) and dated ledger history, not a second copy of the ceiling.
